hook: A three-story building of 1923 divided into twelve condominium units.

narrative.lead: 2760 Sacramento Street is a three-story building of 1923 divided into twelve condominium units, each its own parcel — lots 022 through 033 on block 0632 — numbered 1 through 12. The assessor records the same three stories against every one of the twelve, so that figure is the building's.
